context: DI found a bounded read-only recovery path and blocked a new payment mutation while the prior commit state remained unknown.
decision: Recover the authoritative transaction state for the existing logical operation before any new financial mutation; if an existing committed effect is confirmed, accept it and do not pay again.
options: Recover the authoritative transaction state for the existing logical operation.
Blindly retry the payment as a new mutation.
Stop permanently without resolving the existing transaction state.
rationale: A lost acknowledgement is ambiguous. Read-before-write recovery preserves the existing operation identity and avoids creating a second effect.

native_stack_bridge_v0_1.selected_path: recover authoritative transaction state before any new mutation
